name: EPIC 206201523
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 11.5 solar radii and 0.82 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,043 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.82 solar masses and 11.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,556 K at its surface.
